think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and intended meaning in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether the knob’s numeric domain includes sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior). 3) Verify from PostgreSQL semantics whether any such value changes the function beyond the normal ordered interpretation. 4) If no sentinel values exist and the knob always represents the same kind of quantity (just larger/smaller), classify it as not special.
